F2.0a.criterion: coverage is reported per universe rather than as one threshold: current members 100%, point-in-time members with prices by year (the Task 0 table); the criterion passes if the table is stored and MODEL_START is recorded.
F2.0a.note: Table in sprints/E2/PROBES.md, MODEL_START in docs/hygiene_ledger.md.

F2.0b.criterion: interior NaN return rows (302 rows, 13 tickers) are excluded from every regression window and never forward-filled; the criterion passes if a test proves a regression window containing a NaN row drops that row rather than imputing it.

F2.0c.criterion: adjusted-close audit mean below 0.1 bp, and every audited day with an absolute difference above 50 bp appears in events.parquet with a cause (the 221 bp BKR day is a merger). Passes when both hold.
F2.0c.threshold: mean < 0.1 bp and every day above 50 bp has an event with a cause
F2.0c.note: Large days are the 20-name audit sample above 50 bp, all matched to events.parquet.

F2.1.criterion: Full-sample OLS beta vs mean of rolling 252d betas: cross-sectional correlation above 0.9.
F2.1.note: Full-sample OLS market beta vs the time mean of the rolling 252d beta.

F2.2.criterion: Mean pairwise correlation of FF5+MOM residuals across the universe below 0.05. Higher means a missing common factor; carry the finding into E3.
F2.2.note: Seeded random sample of names with a minimum overlap; carries into E3 if above 0.05.

F2.3.criterion: GARCH(1,1) and EWMA(0.94) each beat trailing 252d vol on out-of-sample QLIKE for more than 60% of names.
F2.3.threshold: GARCH and EWMA(0.94) each beat trailing 252d for > 60% of names
F2.3.note: Win share is the fraction of names whose out-of-sample QLIKE beats trailing 252d vol. GARCH fits only 45 of the names, so the two win shares are not on the same sample: on the 37 names where both are available, GARCH beats EWMA (0.94) for 73.0% of them.

F2.4.criterion: For the equal-weight seed portfolio, bias statistic (realized 63d forward vol over model-predicted vol) averages between 0.8 and 1.2 across calendar years.
F2.4.threshold: mean bias ratio in [0.8, 1.2] across calendar years
F2.4.note: Equal-weight seed book, 63-day forward realized vol over the predicted vol, by year.

F2.5.criterion: Newey-West SE exceeds OLS SE at lag 5 for more than 80% of names. If not, document the direction and why.
F2.5.threshold: Newey-West SE > OLS SE for > 80% of names
F2.5.note: Share of names where the Newey-West market-beta SE exceeds the OLS SE at lag 5.

F2.6.criterion: Successor to F2.3, added on 2026-09-10 after the flagged MI row turned out to be a series break rather than a bad return: no name in the panel has an adjusted-close move above 5x that no recorded split explains. A name above that level has to leave the panel, not just lose the row, because every earlier date carries a different company's returns. This one is not pre-registered, and it is recorded as such.
F2.6.threshold: 0 names with an unexplained adjusted-close move above 5x
F2.6.note: Ticker reuse: a later listing takes the old symbol and the vendor splices both histories, so one company's returns are attributed to another. Fixing it needs a security-identity source (FIGI or PERMNO) and is tracked in docs/open_items.md.
